input: We are planning to migrate from Linux pseudo-NMI to architectural NMI on a GICv3.3 platform. Our current pseudo-NMI is used for perf PMU sampling and the hardware watchdog. What are the key differences between pseudo-NMI and architectural GICv3.3 NMI in terms of kernel configuration, GICD_INMIR setup, and PSTATE.ALLINT handling? What regressions should we test for during the migration?
